profile_text.body:
Wayground, formerly known as Quizizz, is an education technology platform aimed at teachers and school administrators. The company describes itself as helping teachers differentiate instruction with AI and track student progress, with a focus on finding standards-aligned resources that engage students. Its tools are positioned as approachable for all teachers, not just those with a strong technology background.

The platform's AI capabilities are built around everyday classroom tasks, including translating homework pages, adjusting reading levels, adding real-world scenarios to passages, and building student activities. The company distinguishes itself from competitors by combining generative AI with activity delivery and results analysis in a single place, rather than stopping at content generation alone. Academic integrity features are also part of the offering, including lockdown modes, anti-cheating alerts, and academic integrity reports.

Wayground is tracked on this site as an education tooling product under the Search, Research, Translation and Other category. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are currently held for the company.
